free_text: The patient has an elevated PSA of 19.0 ng/mL, a PI-RADS 5 lesion in the left peripheral zone apex, and a history of prostate adenocarcinoma with an ISUP grade group 2 finding. Given the high-risk features, active treatment is indicated. The trade-off involves balancing potential cancer control against the risks associated with treatment in a patient with pre-existing coronary artery disease and chronic kidney disease.
